title: Universal Corporation Announces Universal Ingredients Leadership Transition Plan
summary: Patrick O’Keefe Announces Retirement; Leadership Transition Process Underway Universal Corporation (NYSE: UVV) ("Universal" or the "Company"), a global business-to-business agriproducts company, today announced that Patrick (Pat) O'Keefe has notified the Company of his intention to retire from his positions as Vice President, Ingredients for Universal Corporation and Senior Vice President, Universal Ingredients. The Company has engaged an executive search firm and initiated a process to identify Mr. O’Keefe’s successor. Mr. O'Keefe will remain in his current role until a successor is appointed and will subsequently provide support to ensure a smooth transition process. Preston D. Wigner, Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer of Universal, stated, "Pat has played an important role in shaping Universal Ingredients into the business it is today.
